atoms.text: This is Carla the Cat. She is going to show you around some buildings in the UK.

instruction.text: Answer Carla’s question by listening to the options and selecting the correct answer.

atoms.a: “I know that houses are a form of shelter, but what is shelter?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_2025'>I know that houses are a form of shelter, but what is shelter?</voice>

b.sound: Shelter is a place that gives people protection. For example, a house, a tent or even an igloo!
Shelter is a type of food that cats really like.

instruction.text: Select the three images of houses in the UK.

feedback.finish: Great! Houses in the UK are usually made from brick. It’s a strong material that keeps in the warmth.
feedback.wrong: These are adobe houses in the USA.

instruction.text: This is a brick house. Select the door to learn more.

feedback.end: This is a detached house, which means it isn’t connected to any other houses. Houses that are connected to one other house are called semi-detached houses.

instruction.text: This is a thatched cottage. Select the roof to learn more.

feedback.end: Many old cottages in the UK have thatched roofs. These are roofs that are made from dry plants, such as straw.

instruction.text: These are terraced houses. Select one of the windows to learn more.

feedback.end: Terraced houses are houses that are joined together in a row. These are very common in the UK and Europe.

instruction.text: Which building in a different country looks more similar to a house in the UK? Select the correct image.

feedback.finish: Correct! This is a building in Germany. Germany has similar weather to the UK, so they also use brick for houses.
feedback.wrong: This is a house in Egypt.

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Carla wants to see what the houses in Bath look like. Answer her questions.

atoms.a: “What do you notice about the houses?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_2025'>What do you notice about the houses?</voice>

feedback.end: Houses in a specific area usually look very similar. This is because they are often built in the same style.

atoms.a: “What else is very similar about all the houses?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_2025'>What else is very similar about all the houses?</voice>

feedback.end: They are also often made from the same materials. Many houses in Bath are made from limestone because there is a lot of it in this area.
